{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the sales data
sales_df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Check the data types
dtypes = sales_df.dtypes

# Check for sentinel values in customer_age
sentinel_values = sales_df['customer_age'].unique()

# Filter for customers who converted
target_group = sales_df[sales_df['converted'] == 1]

# Compute the mean age of those who converted
mean_age_converted = target_group['customer_age'].mean()

# Check if there are any invalid ages (e.g., negative)
invalid_ages = target_group[target_group['customer_age'] < 0]

# Return results
dtypes, sentinel_values, mean_age_converted, invalid_ages"}
